raw.attchmntText: Indian Railway Catering And Tourism Corporation Limited has informed the Exchange about copy of Newspaper Publication regarding Q2FY27 Results.
raw.sm_name: Indian Railway Catering And Tourism Corporation Limited
raw.voiceSummary: Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation Limited filed a notice regarding the newspaper publication of un-audited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended on September 30, 2026. Chennai Metro Rail Limited redesigned a critical stretch between Alandur and St Thomas Mount to avoid acquiring defence land. The revised alignment involves constructing Phase 2 of Corridor 5 beneath the existing Chennai Central to St Thomas Mount corridor. This change is expected to save six months of construction time. The additional engineering work involves a supplementary tender worth around 300 crore. Chennai Metro Rail Limited plans a 45-day suspension of train services tentatively in February or March 2027, subject to approval from the Commissioner of Railway Safety. The target for completing the entire elevated stretch towards Sholinganallur is September 2027.

raw.attchmntText: Tata Steel Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
raw.voiceSummary: Tata Steel Limited filed the transcript of its 2QFY27 Earnings Discussion with BSE and NSE. The Board approved financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, on November 7, 2026. Consolidated revenues were Rs 1,26,231 crores with an EBITDA of Rs 20,035 crores, representing a margin of about 16%. India deliveries grew 16% quarter on quarter. The NINL expansion remains on track for commissioning in FY2030. The amalgamation of NINL with Tata Steel is pending final NCLT approval scheduled for November. In the Netherlands, the Direct Sheet Plant restarted in early August with Chromium-6 emissions below prescribed limits. UK deliveries were approximately 0.38 million tons, impacted by elevated imports under transitional safeguard arrangements.

raw.attchmntText: Infosys Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Six Promising Researchers Win the Infosys Prize 2026 Awarded by the Infosys Science Foundation'.
raw.voiceSummary: Infosys Limited issued a press release on November 12, 2026, announcing that the Infosys Science Foundation awarded the Infosys Prize 2026 to six researchers. The laureates are Karthik Sastry in Economics, Swarun Kumar in Engineering and Computer Science, Gautam Bhatia in Humanities and Social Sciences, Isha Jain in Life Sciences, Riddhipratim Basu in Mathematical Sciences, and Manoj Kumar Joshi in Physical Sciences. Each winner receives a gold medal, a citation, and a prize purse of USD 100,000. The prize honors researchers under the age of 40. The winners were selected by an international panel of jurors and announced by the trustees of the Infosys Science Foundation. The information is hosted on the company website at www.infosys.com.

rows.subject: Adani Enterprises Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 12, 2026, titled "Intimation for submission of Media Release for the subject Adani s Kutch Copper and Chile s Codelco Sign Strategic MoU for exploration of Kaburkaala project in Chile".

raw.attchmntText: Adani Enterprises Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 12, 2026, titled "Intimation for submission of Media Release for the subject Adani s Kutch Copper and Chile s Codelco Sign Strategic MoU for exploration of Kaburkaala project in Chile".
raw.voiceSummary: Adani Enterprises Limited submitted a media release regarding its subsidiary Kutch Copper Ltd and Chile’s Codelco signing a strategic Memorandum of Understanding for the exploration of the Kaburkaala copper project in Chile. The agreement aims to link Chilean copper resources with Adani’s integrated copper smelter complex at Mundra, India. The MoU was signed in London during LME Week 2026. This partnership involves capital, technology-led exploration, and project execution capabilities from Adani, combined with Codelco’s geological knowledge. The collaboration supports India’s resource security and Codelco’s strategy to create value from its exploration portfolio through public-private partnerships.
